observations.outcome: The player can control visibility, include fluid targets and narrate the selected target.

observations.title: Open recipes from a world target
observations.player_action: With JEI present, use keypad 3 for recipes or keypad 4 for uses of the target.
observations.outcome: Jade passes the target to the recipe viewer.
conditions: The JEI integration and configured keybindings must exist in the installed release.
